blockingFindings: F1 fixture provenance is undefined and can become circular with F2. F1 P1 (native transcript agreement) and P2 (canonical export/import of IVC verifier state/accumulator) need a native proof transcript and an accumulator instance; P3 needs an 'independently checked nontrivial valid fixture' for a constrained final pairing. The packet states the fixed native candidate is unrun and the original R3 k17 run failed, so no retained loan IVC proof exists, and the plan only says 'use pinned existing independent fixtures where available' without naming any. If the only source of these inputs is the F2 loan proof, F1 (gate for F2) depends on F2's output. Fix: in RP02/backend-probe-plan.md, name the exact fixture source for each probe (e.g., non-loan native test vectors/proofs at midnight-zk pin 695351f, or a synthetic KZG accumulator pair from the pinned SRS for P3, or a small non-loan IVC test circuit for P2), record each as an existing pinned artifact or an explicitly admitted bounded generation sub-stage, and state that no F1 fixture may be the MC03 loan proof.

The F2/I2 prerequisite 'MC01 acceptance' is not defined as a specific milestone and conflicts with RP01 gating. The reconciliation says the full RP01 design map is not a prerequisite for unchanged fixed-instance F2, but the roadmap's MC01 checklist and acceptance sentence include RP01-derived extensions (source intent/plan/receipt objects, outcome/liability/residual/temporal constructs), and the register lists RP01 as an MC01 planning prerequisite. If 'MC01 acceptance' means the extended profile, F2 and I2 silently wait on full RP01, contradicting the staged design. Fix: name a milestone (e.g., 'MC01 atomic-profile acceptance' = input-boundary correction + current Fable 5.1 medium/GPT-6 implementation audits of the existing atomic subset at a pinned candidate hash) as the sole MC01 prerequisite for I2/F2, and move RP01-gated extension items to a separately labeled MC01 extension track.

RP01 subset gating is not representable in the gate records or register, so a dispatcher checking RP prerequisites would either block MC02/MC03 on full RP01 completion or have nothing to check. The gate record schema allows only one status per gate (specified-only/pending-review/blocked/complete); RP01-MC03 subset artifacts are said to live in RP02's backend-decision.json, the RP01-MC02 subset has no stated record location, and the register lists bare 'RP01' as a planning prerequisite for MC02/MC03 with scope 'Successor semantic freeze and campaign dispatch'. Fix: define subset entries (RP01-MC02, RP01-MC03) with their own scope, inputs, candidate hashes, review receipts and status inside semantic-challenges.json (or one declared file), and make the register's planningPrerequisites and preMc03Predicate reference those subset IDs rather than gate-level RP01 status.

F0a authorship of the constrained final pairing and the target ledger family are committed before their feasibility and deployment target are decided. The MC04 record shows the native final check is a host-side two-pair pairing (DualMSM::check) with no constrained pairing found in pinned circuits/stdlib, that ledger-8 exposes only V2 while ledger-9 has a V3 route, and that which family Preview actually runs is unresolved. Enforcing a BLS12-381 pairing inside a circuit over that curve's scalar field implies non-native field/Fq12 arithmetic of unknown and likely very large constraint cost; the plan gives no estimate, no k/SRS bound check, and no no-go criterion specific to this component, yet F0a assigns MC04 to build it under a 'bounded preparation allocation'. Fix: make F0 exit require (a) a recorded feasibility disposition for the constrained pairing (arithmetic requirements, constraint/k estimate method, fit against the ledger backend's k and SRS limits, and explicit no-go/alternative routes), and (b) a recorded ledger-family decision (ledger-8 V2 vs ledger-9 V3) with deployment-provenance evidence or an explicitly labeled assumption; F0a authorship may not start until both are reviewed.
nonblockingFindings: ROADMAP mermaid diagram omits RP02, RP03, F0a and the RP03 admission edges into MC02/MC03/MC04, and shows F0 with no input from the MC04 source record; align the diagram with the text so readers do not infer that RP01 alone gates MC02/MC03.

ROADMAP 'What exists' asserts 'A previous Preview deployment and call finalized with exact state readback. That demonstrates basic network integration.' No receipt, transaction id or hash is cited in the packet and the user states no external deployment facts are established; cite the retained receipt path/hash and scope the sentence (hello-world call only, no financial effect).
ROADMAP references DS-01 through DS-07 (MC07) and charter G01-G24 (MC08) that are not defined or linked anywhere in the packet; add links to their definitions.

Register MC03 status 'encoding-source-dual-approved-awaiting-mc01' and MC03 commands under revision-01/run-reviewed.py conflict with the reconciliation's statement that the retained runner is run-checked-encoding.py and that both are 'starting inputs, not approved successor commands'; relabel the status to name the legacy reviewer scope and mark commands legacy until RP03 freezes new ones.

RP03 bullet 'Derive a complete episode manifest and revise campaign bounds ... before dispatch' reads as applying to every dispatch, while the staged section says RP03 never requires a full MC07 manifest before MC02/MC03 probes; scope the bullet explicitly to MC07 campaigns.

campaign-admission.json is a single gate record but RP03 is 'complete only for that exact admitted campaign'; specify a per-campaign record set (one record per admitted stage/campaign with candidate hashes) and how the register's single RP03 status maps to it.

Package reservations sum exactly to the 850 master minutes (60+385+35+85+50+50+50+110+25), so there is zero unallocated headroom for F0a/F1 work; state this in the plan and require the F0a reservation amendment to be recorded before any preparation dispatch, not merely 'before F1'.

The plan says 'fresh GPT-6' without effort while the register sets gpt-6-astra to 'high'; state the required GPT-6 effort in the gate record schema so candidate-bound reviews are comparable, and require provider-identity verification from the response per the Fable-return instruction.

The 'MC01 correction/review may continue' allowance does not say whether MC01 acceptance test runs count as 'campaign dispatch' needing RP03 admission; clarify to avoid a dispatcher stalling MC01 acceptance (and therefore F2/I2) on RP03.

RP01 lists the twelve extra DeFi holdouts as candidate challenges needing pinned primary sources but assigns no owner or closure task for obtaining those sources; add an explicit owner/closure row so they do not silently drop out of the design matrix.

Accepted as correctly stated in the plan: product target and override of the three reports' contrary recommendations with accurate line citations; rejection of unbounded domains and optional/deferred PCD; treatment of NEAR/EVM/Cardano as comparative only; preservation of the full corpus denominators and the 349-is-not-coverage caveat; faithful use of the MC04 wrapper-interface-source-02 findings (preparation gadget lacks final pairing, host DualMSM check, pub(crate) IVC fields, transcript trailing-byte limits, ledger-8 V2 only, ledger-9 V3 route unaligned to Preview); the F0-F4 staging concept, prohibition of host verification booleans and nonrecursive substitute proofs, and the terminal Preview acceptance predicate.
